methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing collected from each vendor's official pricing page (accessed 2026-06-14 where reachable) and cross-checked against reputable aggregators (GetApp, SoftwareAdvice). Where the official page is JS-rendered or returns non-USD content the provenance field notes the fallback source used. Quote-only tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd = null — no prices are guessed. Usage-metered plans record the lowest published committed tier as monthlyUsd where available, with per-unit rates in notes. Hull.io was excluded: the domain returns a TLS certificate error and appears to be dormant/defunct. Twilio Engage has no self-serve pricing page; its plans are all custom/quote-only. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on every plan because this is a non-telephony vertical.
